notes.title: Improvement Patch Released! & Reviews exceed 100!
notes.content: [h2][b]■Improvement patch now available. Thank you for over 100 reviews![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451542/c92bd9f807cad3b8d838c07772e920a5c8b1470b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of “Holo's Hanafuda”![/p][p]Since release, we've been incredibly grateful to see so many people playing the game and receiving your supportive messages and suggestions for improvement.[/p][p]Your reviews, community hub posts, livestreams, and social media shares have been a tremendous encouragement to the entire development team.[/p][p][/p][p]We have now released the following improvement patch:[/p][p][/p][p][b]・Added an option to skip a losing match in Adventure Mode.[/b][/p][p][b]・Added an option to adjust the text display speed in Adventure Mode.[/b][/p][p][b]・Added penalty functionality when disconnecting in the middle of an online match.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, the first DLC is currently [b]10% OFF for a limited time[/b], so please consider purchasing it if you're interested[b].[/b][/p]

tags.feature: ・Added an option to skip a losing match in Adventure Mode.
・Added an option to adjust the text display speed in Adventure Mode.
・Added penalty functionality when disconnecting in the middle of an online match.
